newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bridgestone up on expected profits leap.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone up on expected profits leap.

text.p: Shares in Bridgestone Corp climbed on Wednesday morning, supported by a newspaper report that the firm is expected to post its biggest ever annual group and parent profits this year.
The share price of the major tyre manufacturer was up 40 yen at 2,120 yen at 0118 GMT, in a volume of 368,000 shares.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Wednesday that Bridgestone's parent current profit for the year to December 31, 1996, is expected to be 92 billion yen, which would be its biggest on record. It will be helped by active demand for tyres in Asia and the weaker yen, it said.
